thread:
maya: Quick sync — planning the Sparkwave launch posts + webinar. Want to bundle: free starter credits (50), a prompt-template pack, and a 20-min 'Getting to First Useful Response' onboarding nudge. Also want a short benchmark narrative (latency/cost vs sample app) to hand to sales. Target: +20% <10-run activation in week 1. Thoughts?

alejandro: Love it. Two quick asks: 1) split-credit cohort vs no-credit for the first 3 days; 2) two headline variants for launch post (developer-first vs outcome-first). I can run the A/B hooks. :rocket:

jun: For inbound routing — tag users who use the prompt pack within 24h as "high-intent-webinar" and route to the fast lane funnel in Segment. Can we add a query param on webinar CTA so we know who came from the post vs email?

maya: yes on the param. let's use ?src=sparkwave_post and ?src=welcome_email. jun do you own the segment tagging?

jun: yep i'll add the trait and a webhook to update CRM lead source. I'll also create a short playbook for SDRs: if usage > 100 tokens and no team invite within 72h -> outreach.

sam: Webinar logistics — 30 min: 10-min demo (prompt pack + templates), 10-min benchmarking story + Q&A. Proposed date: two weeks from launch. I pushed a stub in the calendar. Also drafted two social copy directions, dropping below.

sam: (copy A - developer-first)
```
We built Sparkwave — a low-latency inference pipeline for devs. Try it free: 50 credits + prompt templates to ship an LLM feature in hours. Register for our launch demo -> [link]?src=sparkwave_post :rocket:
```

sam: (copy B - outcome-first)
```
Ship customer-facing features that save ~2-10 developer hours per week. Get 50 starter credits + built prompt packs. Live demo + benchmarks next Wed. Sign up -> [link]?src=sparkwave_post
```

olivia: For metrics, I'll own the dashboard: activation rate (<10 runs), 7-day retention, cost-per-activated-user, and webinar signups -> demo->converted leads. Need event names: `credit_redeemed`, `prompt_pack_installed`, `first_response_time`. Can we standardize those?

maya: agreed. use those exact event names. olivia can you create the dashboard by EOD Fri?

olivia: yes. I'll add a cohort comparison: credit cohort vs no-credit, and prompt-pack vs no-prompt-pack.

maya: Messaging for onboarding nudge — rough two-line sequence: push1 (immediate): "Welcome! Use your 50 starter credits — try the 'Prompt Quickstart' template to see results in under 3 minutes." push2 (24h): "Need a headstart? Join our 20-min demo tomorrow at X to see the prompt templates in action." paste below for ops.

sam: I'll prepare short banner and 3 tweet-length posts for launch. We should also prepare a short benchmark thread (1-2 slides) showing perf + cost vs vanilla hosting. I'll pair with a 60s video clip for social.

alejandro: Experiment matrix idea: 1) credit amount (50 vs 0) 2) onboarding nudge timing (immediate vs 6h delay) 3) post headline (A vs B). Run factorial in first week, measure primary metric <10-run activation.

maya: Good. Owners: alejandro -> experiment setup + post variants. jun -> routing & tagging + playbook. sam -> copy + webinar assets + social video. olivia -> dashboard and event instrumentation. I'll coordinate messaging cadence and the launch calendar. Deadline for all assets: launch-3 days (prep freeze 48h).

ops-bot: Reminder: calendar event created by sam for "Sparkwave Launch Demo" on 3501242000. RSVP requested.

maya: Final note — can we include a quick one-click "try with template" CTA in the post landing page that preloads the prompt pack into the user's workspace? If engineering can support a deep-link, that should increase conversion. @eng-devex ping if this is feasible.

alejandro: I'll add the deep-link as a hidden field in the post link if devex can expose endpoint `POST /v1/user/:id/import-template?src=sparkwave_post`. If not, fallback to a guided import flow.

jun: OK let's document the fallback flow in the SDR playbook so no leads slip.

maya: Nice work team. Quick checklist before EOD: asset list, experiment matrix, routing docs, dashboard skeleton, webinar slide deck stub. I'll do a short runbook for launch-day comms. :white_check_mark:

sam: dropping final copy & one-pager by tomorrow AM.

olivia: dashboard draft by Fri EOD.

alejandro: experiment flags and post variants by Tue.

jun: routing + webhook + SDR playbook by Tue.

maya: thanks — will follow up with a short Loom summarizing this thread. :stars:
